release_notes: Build 133 fixes the startup crash caused by optional quiz-folder cleanup when the Projects Folder setting is blank or unavailable.
Startup folder maintenance is now non-fatal, so the app can open normally and Settings remains accessible even when the Projects Folder needs attention.
Operations that genuinely require a Projects Folder still keep the existing strict validation and clear Settings error.
Build 132's startup UI hotfix and Build 131's safer Library and Autopilot performance improvements remain in place.
